race.comment: FIERCE DREAMS (9) was a winner over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic last time out, dropping out early before coming home with a powerful run to score by one length. The rise to 1400m suits and should be blending in nicely from her middle draw. Bold showing anticipated. DOUBLE PI (7) was a good winner here two back and then went desperately close to repeating the dose last time. Keeps the 3kg claimer and rates a big hope again. BANKNOTE HUSTLER (2) has been well travelled this prep but looks well placed staying at this track and level. Carries a big weight but gets the key booking of Brown. Gets a good chance to put it all together. SAVANNAH CHILL (10) was unwanted in betting last time but scored well over this trip. Have to take more seriously this time. CASH CONVERTER (4) held on well to finish third last time out over the mile at Cranbourne after leading for much of the way. Solid run last start and is among the chances again.
